name: Zombie
spawn: Overworld surface or caves at light level 0
behavior: Relentlessly pursues players and villagers in groups; attacks doors on Hard difficulty.
rareDrop: Iron Ingot, Carrot, or Potato (2.5% chance)

variants.name: Husk
variants.description: Spawns in Deserts; does not burn in direct sunlight and inflicts Hunger.

variants.name: Drowned
variants.description: Spawns in Oceans and Rivers; swims swiftly and can throw Tridents.

variants.name: Zombie Villager
variants.description: Infected villager that can be cured with a Splash Potion of Weakness and a Golden Apple.

variants.name: Baby Zombie
variants.description: 30% faster movement speed, 1-block height, and does not burn in sunlight.

description: The quintessential undead monster of Minecraft, prowling the dark in pursuit of players and defenseless villagers.

name: Skeleton
spawn: Overworld surface or caves at light level 0
behavior: Ranged sniper that strafes away from approaching players while releasing accurate arrows.
rareDrop: Bow (8.5% chance), Skeleton Skull (when killed by charged creeper)

variants.name: Stray
variants.description: Frozen skeleton found in icy tundras; fires tipped arrows of Slowness.

variants.name: Bogged
variants.description: Mossy swamp skeleton added in 1.21; fires Poison arrows and can be sheared for mushrooms.

variants.name: Skeleton Horseman
variants.description: Spawned by lightning skeleton traps; rides an invincible skeleton trap horse with iron gear.

description: Deadly ranged archers that maintain distance, burn in daylight, and fire continuous volleys at intruders.

name: Creeper
spawn: Overworld at light level 0 on solid blocks
behavior: Silently sneaks up behind players and detonates after a 1.5 second hissing fuse.
drops: Music Disc (if slain by a skeleton's arrow)
rareDrop: Mob Head (if killed by a Charged Creeper explosion)

variants.name: Charged Creeper
variants.description: Created when struck by lightning; features a pulsing blue aura and doubled explosive radius (up to 97 damage on Hard).

description: Minecraft's silent mascot of destruction, creeping soundlessly before unleashing devastating point-blank explosions.

name: Spider
spawn: Overworld at light level 0 with 2x2 horizontal space
behavior: Climbs vertical walls effortlessly and leaps toward targets; neutral in daylight (light level 9+).

variants.name: Cave Spider
variants.description: Smaller, bluish variant found in abandoned mineshafts; fits into 0.5-block gaps and inflicts lethal Poison.

variants.name: Spider Jockey
variants.description: 1% chance spawn with an archer Skeleton riding on its back for combined speed and ranged firepower.

description: Agile eight-legged predators that scale walls, pounce on unsuspecting adventurers, and turn neutral under bright daylight.

name: Enderman
spawn: Overworld, Nether, and The End at light level 0 (light 0–7 in The End)
behavior: Peaceful until a player gazes into its purple eyes or attacks; teleports rapidly and takes severe damage from water.

variants.name: Block-Carrying Enderman
variants.description: Can pick up and relocate natural blocks like dirt, sand, gravel, and flowers.

variants.name: End Colony Enderman
variants.description: Massive populations native to The End outer islands, congregating peacefully until disturbed.

description: Towering shadowy wanderers from The End who harness instant teleportation and become fiercely aggressive when stared at.

name: Witch
spawn: Overworld light level 0, Swamp Huts, or lightning strike on a Villager
behavior: Hurls harmful splash potions (Slowness, Poison, Harming) while self-medicating with potions of Healing and Fire Resistance.
rareDrop: Potion of Healing, Swiftness, or Fire Resistance (8.5% chance if killed while drinking)

variants.name: Swamp Hut Witch
variants.description: Guards natural swamp huts accompanied by a black cat.

variants.name: Raid Witch
variants.description: Supports illager raid waves by healing raid captains and bombarding defenders with status effects.

description: Cackling alchemists who brew caustic concoctions, support village raids, and drink defensive potions under duress.

name: Slime
spawn: Specific Slime Chunks below Y=40, or Swamps between Y=50–70 at night
behavior: Bounces toward targets; splits into smaller copies upon defeat until the smallest size drops sticky slimeballs.
drops: Slimeball (0–2, dropped only by small slimes)

variants.name: Big Slime
variants.description: Size 4 cube with 16 HP; divides into 2–4 Medium Slimes upon death.

variants.name: Medium Slime
variants.description: Size 2 cube with 4 HP; divides into 2–4 Small Slimes upon death.

variants.name: Small Slime
variants.description: Size 1 cube with 1 HP; completely harmless to players and the sole source of Slimeballs.

description: Bouncy gelatinous cubes that thrive in humid swamps and deep subterranean caverns, multiplying as they take damage.

name: Ghast
spawn: Nether biomes on solid blocks with at least 5x5x5 clearance
behavior: Drifts lazily through the Nether skies, emitting sorrowful cries before firing explosive fireballs that players can deflect.

variants.name: Nether Glider
variants.description: Massive 4x4x4 floating specter whose fireballs can blow open portals or be deflected back with weapon swings.

description: Haunting floating leviathans of the Nether that wail mournfully and launch explosive fire charges across fiery chasms.

name: Blaze
spawn: Nether Fortresses at light level 11 or lower
behavior: Hovers into the air, ignites, and launches a three-round burst of fireballs that set victims ablaze.
drops: Blaze Rod (0–1 when killed directly by player or tamed wolf)

variants.name: Fortress Spawner Blaze
variants.description: Constantly generated by ancient caged spawners on elevated fortress catwalks.

description: Floating elemental constructs composed of whirling smoking rods, guarding Nether Fortresses with rapid bursts of flame.

name: Breeze
spawn: Trial Chambers via Trial Spawners (1.21 Tricky Trials)
behavior: Leaps frantically around chamber obstacles, firing pressurized wind charges that knock players back and activate redstone.

variants.name: Trial Chamber Guardian
variants.description: Defends deep underground copper chambers; its wind projectiles trigger trapdoors, buttons, and dispensers.

description: An airborne wind elemental introduced in Minecraft 1.21, bounding acrobatically across Trial Chambers with gusts of gale-force power.

name: Warden
spawn: Summoned in Deep Dark after 4 Sculk Shrieker activations
behavior: Completely blind; stalks players using sculk vibrations and smell. Can unleash an armor-piercing sonic boom at range.

variants.name: Deep Dark Stalker
variants.description: The terrifying apex predator of the Deep Dark; meant to be sneaked past rather than fought head-on.

description: The monstrous blind sentinel of Ancient Cities, capable of neutralizing fully-armored warriors in a single sonic strike.

name: Pig
spawn: Grassy Overworld biomes at light level 9+
behavior: Peacefully roams green pastures in herds; can be equipped with a saddle and steered using a Carrot on a Stick.
drops: Raw Porkchop (1–3, cooked if slain by fire)

variants.name: Saddled Pig
variants.description: Can be mounted and steered by holding a Carrot on a Stick, granting speed bursts.

variants.name: Zombified Piglin
variants.description: Created instantly if struck directly by lightning during thunderstorms.

description: The friendly, snorting pasture regular of Minecraft, ready to provide nutritious porkchops or serve as an amusing mount.

name: Cow
spawn: Grassy Overworld biomes at light level 9+
behavior: Grazes peacefully across sunny hillsides; provides endless milk when clicked with an empty iron bucket.
drops: Raw Beef (1–3, cooked if slain by fire)

variants.name: Mooshroom (Red)
variants.description: Mushroom island native covered in red mushrooms; can be milked with a wooden bowl for Mushroom Stew.

variants.name: Mooshroom (Brown)
variants.description: Rare variant created when a Red Mooshroom is struck by lightning; produces Suspicious Stew when fed small flowers.

description: A staple farm animal essential for leather armor, enchanting books, steaks, and buckets of milk that cure all potion effects.

name: Sheep
spawn: Grassy Overworld biomes at light level 9+
behavior: Grazes on grass blocks to regrow its coat; can be dyed any of 16 vibrant colors and shorn using Shears.

variants.name: Natural Colors
variants.description: Spawns in White (81.8%), Black (5%), Gray (5%), Light Gray (5%), Brown (3%), or ultra-rare Pink (0.164%).

variants.name: jeb_ (Rainbow)
variants.description: Named with a Name Tag 'jeb_' to create an undulating rainbow wool color-cycle effect.

description: Gentle wool-bearers that keep grassy hills mowed, yielding colorful fleece for warm beds and banners.

name: Villager
spawn: Naturally generated Villages or cured Zombie Villagers
behavior: Gathers for town gossip, sleeps in designated beds, works at job workstations, and trades goods for emeralds.

variants.name: 7 Regional Outfits
variants.description: Wears unique regional attire based on home biome: Plains, Desert, Savanna, Taiga, Snowy, Jungle, and Swamp.

variants.name: 15 Professions
variants.description: Ranges from Mending Librarians and Armorers to Toolsmiths, Clerics, and green-robed Nitwits.

description: Resourceful, long-nosed traders inhabiting settlements across the world, offering vital enchanted books and high-tier equipment.

name: Allay
spawn: Cages at Pillager Outposts and cells in Woodland Mansions
behavior: Flies gracefully alongside players; when given an item, seeks out and collects matching dropped items from the surroundings.

variants.name: Dancing Allay
variants.description: Dances ecstatically when standing near an active jukebox; duplicates when given an Amethyst Shard while dancing.

description: Luminous, sprite-like helpers rescued from illager captors, eager to gather matching scattered resources for their companions.

name: Armadillo
spawn: Savannas and Badlands biomes (1.21 Tricky Trials)
behavior: Wanders warm arid terrains; rolls into an impenetrable shell when startled by running players or nearby undead mobs.
rareDrop: Armadillo Scute (brushed with a Brush or shed periodically)

variants.name: Curled Defense
variants.description: Tucks limbs into an armored sphere, drastically mitigating incoming damage and deterring hostile strikes.

description: A shy, armored critter introduced in Minecraft 1.21 that curls into a protective ball and yields scutes to craft durable wolf armor.

name: Iron Golem
spawn: Generated in villages with panicked villagers or built by players
behavior: Faithfully patrols village borders; flings hostile mobs high into the air with towering uppercuts.

variants.name: Village Protector
variants.description: Spawns naturally to defend villagers; attacks players if village popularity drops below -15.

variants.name: Player-Crafted Golem
variants.description: Constructed from 4 Iron Blocks and 1 Carved Pumpkin; forever loyal to its builder.

variants.name: Cracked States
variants.description: Visually cracks as its health depletes; restored by clicking with Iron Ingots.

description: Colossal metallic guardians crafted from iron and pumpkins, offering Poppies to villagers and tossing intruders into the sky.

name: Wolf
spawn: Forests, Taigas, and Savannas based on regional variant
behavior: Hunts sheep and skeletons in packs; tamed with bones to become a steadfast bodyguard that attacks targets on command.

variants.name: 9 Biome Coats (1.21)
variants.description: Pale (Taiga), Woods (Forest), Ashen (Snowy Taiga), Black (Pine Taiga), Chestnut (Spruce Taiga), Rusty (Jungle), Spotted (Savanna), Striped (Badlands), and Snowy (Grove).

variants.name: Equipped with Wolf Armor
variants.description: Can be outfitted with craftable Wolf Armor forged from Armadillo Scutes to absorb damage.

description: Loyal canine companions expanded in 1.21 with nine regional coat variations and protective craftable armadillo armor.

name: Ender Dragon
spawn: The End central island
behavior: Swoops down from the obsidian pillars, perches on the bedrock fountain, breathes caustic purple dragon breath, and heals via End Crystals.
drops: Opens exit portal and Gateway to outer End islands

variants.name: Respawned Dragon
variants.description: Can be resurrected atop the exit portal using 4 craftable End Crystals; drops 500 XP upon subsequent defeats.

description: The gargantuan sovereign ruler of The End, dominating the skies above obsidian spires and guarding the Gateway to the void.

name: Wither
spawn: Player-constructed using 4 Soul Sand/Soul Soil in a T-shape topped with 3 Wither Skeleton Skulls
behavior: Hovering three-headed undead calamity that launches explosive skulls, inflicts Wither decay, and activates an arrow-proof armor shield below 50% health.

variants.name: Wither Armor Shield
variants.description: Activates at half health; grants total immunity to projectile arrows and charges into melee range.

description: A player-summoned three-headed titan of pure decay, firing volatile wither skulls and yielding the Nether Star required for beacons.
